messages.content: amar ekta relationship e ami always chasing feel kori, ora effort kom dey
Kotodin dhore eta feel korcho, notun pattern naki always emon chilo?
prai shuru theke e, but recently beshi notice korchi

Noticing more often usually means you're finally paying attention to something that was always there, not that it suddenly got worse. Tumi ki ekbar test kore dekhecho - effort deya bondho kore dekho ki hoy?
na kori nai, bhoy lagche relationship ta e shesh hoye jabe

That fear itself is worth sitting with - if pulling back would end things, that tells you something important about how one-sided it already is. It's not about testing them, it's about seeing the relationship clearly without you carrying all the effort.
